samples.source: 路由表是数据驱动的：routes.json、settings.json、环境变量、初始化 JSON 四级优先级依次覆盖。
samples.reference: The routing table is data-driven with four precedence levels in order: routes.json < settings.json < environment variables < initialisation JSON.
samples.hypothesis: The route table is data-driven: the priority order is defined by routes.json, settings.json, environment variables, and initialization JSON.

samples.source: 端到端评测的样本要按子领域打标签，才能算出 "流水线核心 vs 多义词边界" 的分组质量差。
samples.reference: End-to-end evaluation samples carry sub-domain labels so per-group quality deltas ("pipeline core vs polysemy boundary") can be computed.
samples.hypothesis: The end-to-end evaluation samples need to be labeled by sub-domain to calculate the group quality difference between "streamline core vs multi-word boundary".

samples.source: 批量本地化的性能指标是 "每小时能翻多少段"，与实时场景的 "端到端多少毫秒" 是两套。
samples.reference: The performance metric for batch localisation is sentences per hour; the realtime metric is end-to-end milliseconds -- two completely different scales.
samples.hypothesis: The performance metrics for batch localization are "how many segments can be translated per hour", while those for real-time scenarios are "how many milliseconds from end to end".

samples.source: 桌面产品的首次启动体验很重要：模型缺失时要在 UI 里明说而不是抛异常。
samples.reference: The first-launch experience of a desktop product matters: missing models must surface as a friendly UI message, not an exception.
samples.hypothesis: The first startup experience of desktop products is very important: when the model is missing, it should be explicitly stated in the UI instead of throwing an exception.

samples.source: 本地模型的下载要能显示进度并支持断点续传，几百 MB 到几 GB 的模型不适合一刀断重来。
samples.reference: Local model downloads must show progress and support resumable fetch; hundreds of megabytes to gigabytes are not worth restarting from zero.
samples.hypothesis: The download of the local model should display progress and support resuming from a breakpoint. Models ranging from several hundred MB to several GB are not suitable for a complete restart.

samples.source: 精译档与实时档的切换粒度是每请求；同一批里可以混着走，不用切档。
samples.reference: Switching between quality and realtime mode happens per request; a single batch can freely mix them without a global toggle.
samples.hypothesis: The switching granularity between the refined and real-time files is per request; they can mix together within the same batch without requiring file switching.

samples.source: sidecar 的生命周期由 UI 层管理，启动时轮询健康检查，退出时优雅 kill。
samples.reference: The sidecar's lifecycle is managed by the UI layer -- health-poll on startup, graceful kill on shutdown.
samples.hypothesis: The lifecycle of sidecar is managed by the UI layer. It polls for health checks upon startup, and performs a graceful kill upon exit.

samples.source: Python 侧车与 Rust 核心之间是 HTTP/JSON 契约，禁止 native binding 引入新的依赖负担。
samples.reference: The contract between the Python sidecar and the Rust core is HTTP over JSON, with native bindings forbidden so no new dependency burden creeps in.
samples.hypothesis: There is an HTTP/JSON contract between the Python side and the Rust core, preventing native binding from introducing additional dependency burdens.

samples.source: Windows 智能应用控制会拦截未签名的本地构建 DLL，产品发布签名要覆盖所有二进制。
samples.reference: Windows Smart App Control intercepts unsigned locally built DLLs, so product signing must cover every binary shipped.
samples.hypothesis: Windows Smart Application Control will block unsigned local build DLLs, and product release signing must cover all binaries.

samples.source: 许可证门禁覆盖 Cargo.lock、Python requirements、.NET csproj 与文档引用的第三方素材。
samples.reference: The licence gate covers Cargo.lock, Python requirements, .NET csproj files, and any third-party material referenced from the docs.
samples.hypothesis: The license access covers Cargo.lock, Python requirements, .NET csproj, and third-party materials referenced in the documentation.

samples.source: 源码注释统一英文；文档面向中文用户，中英双版按 README 起头互链。
samples.reference: Source-code comments are English throughout; user-facing documentation is Chinese with an English twin linked from the README.
samples.hypothesis: Source code comments are standardized in English; the documentation is for Chinese users, with both Chinese and English versions linked to each other starting with README.

samples.source: 所有对外发布的数字都要能追溯到一次可复现的评测运行，含脚本、种子、时间戳。
samples.reference: Every externally published number must trace back to a reproducible evaluation run -- script, seed and timestamp included.
samples.hypothesis: All publicly released numbers must be traceable to a reproducible testing run, including scripts, seeds, and timestamps.

samples.source: 文档中不出现机器盘符路径；所有默认路径都走 data_dir 解析。
samples.reference: Docs must not carry machine drive paths; every default path resolves through data_dir.
samples.hypothesis: No machine drive path appears in the document; all default paths are resolved through data_dir.

samples.source: 构建入口以 Python 脚本为主，Windows 与 Linux 各配一个 .bat / .sh 做 OS 级薄壳。
samples.reference: Build entry points are Python scripts, with a thin .bat on Windows and .sh on Linux as OS-level wrappers.
samples.hypothesis: The entry point is primarily a Python script, with a .bat/.sh file for each of Windows and Linux to serve as an OS-level shell.

samples.source: pre-commit 钩子按路径触发不同检查，全绿才允许 commit。
samples.reference: The pre-commit hook dispatches different checks by file path and only allows a commit when every applicable check passes.
samples.hypothesis: Pre-commit hooks trigger different checks based on the path, and only when all checks pass can the commit be accepted.

samples.source: Conventional Commits 是提交信息规范，type(scope): subject 一行说清 "改了什么的哪部分"。
samples.reference: Conventional Commits is the message convention: type(scope): subject says "what changed in which part" in a single line.
samples.hypothesis: Conventional Commits is a commit message convention, with type(scope): subject on one line specifying "what part was changed".

samples.source: pathspec 限定提交是并发协作下的原子性保障；共享暂存区容易被别的会话扫走。
samples.reference: Pathspec-scoped commits are the atomicity guarantee in concurrent collaboration; a shared staging area is easily swept by another session's commit.
samples.hypothesis: Pathspec ensures the submission is atomic under concurrent collaboration; the shared cache area can be easily cleared by other sessions.

samples.source: patch 文件要显式说明行尾策略，Windows 下 autocrlf=true 检出可能破坏 git apply。
samples.reference: Patch files must state their line-ending policy explicitly; under autocrlf=true on Windows a checkout may otherwise break git apply.
samples.hypothesis: The patch file should explicitly specify the line ending policy. On Windows, autocrlf=true may cause issues when checking out, as it may be incompatible with git apply.

samples.source: "缓存" 在 CDN 语境是 cache，在视频缓冲语境通常是 buffer；两者混用会误导读者。
samples.reference: "缓存" is cache in a CDN context but buffer in a video buffering context; conflating them misleads the reader.
samples.hypothesis: "Cache" in the CDN context refers to cache, while in video buffering context it is usually referred to as buffer; mixing both terms may mislead the reader.

samples.source: "编码器" 与 "加密器" 中文近似但英文完全不同：encoder 与 encryptor，翻译不能滑。
samples.reference: "编码器" and "加密器" are near-homographs in Chinese but encoder and encryptor in English -- the translation must not slide.
samples.hypothesis: encoder and encryptor are similar in Chinese but completely different in English; the translation must be accurate.

samples.source: "解码器" 与 "解密器" 同样易混：decoder 与 decryptor，看是压缩域还是安全域。
samples.reference: "解码器" and "解密器" are equally confusable: decoder versus decryptor -- decide by compression domain or security domain.
samples.hypothesis: "Decoder" and "decryptor" are similarly confusing: decoder and decryptor, depending on whether it's in the compression domain or the security domain.

samples.source: "关键帧" 是 video keyframe；"关键帧动画" 是 animation keyframe；同名不同物。
samples.reference: A video keyframe and an animation keyframe share the Chinese term "关键帧" but denote different things.
samples.hypothesis: "Keyframe" is video keyframe; "keyframe animation" is animation keyframe; they are similar in name but different in meaning.

samples.source: "声道" 与 "通道" 在英文都是 channel；中文 UI 要根据域强制选一个不能默认。
samples.reference: "声道" and "通道" both render as channel in English; the UI must pick one explicitly by domain rather than default.
samples.hypothesis: "Channel" and "pathway" are both translated as "channel" in English; in the Chinese UI, one of them must be selected forcibly and cannot be default.

samples.source: "分词" 在 NLP 是 tokenization，在中文文本处理还可能是 word segmentation，两者粒度不同。
samples.reference: "分词" is tokenization in NLP but may be word segmentation in Chinese text processing -- the two operate at different granularity.
samples.hypothesis: "Word segmentation" in NLP is known as tokenization, while in Chinese text processing, it may also refer to word segmentation; the granularity of the two is different.

samples.source: "重采样" 在音频域是 resample，在统计域是 bootstrap 采样；上下文域决定译法。
samples.reference: "重采样" in audio is resampling; in statistics it is bootstrap sampling -- the surrounding domain decides the rendering.
samples.hypothesis: "Resampling" in the audio domain is resample, while in the statistical domain it is bootstrap sampling; the context determines the translation.

samples.source: "预训练" 与 "预热" 在中文里都含 "pre"，英文是 pretraining 与 warmup，工程语义完全不同。
samples.reference: "预训练" and "预热" both start with "pre-" in Chinese, but they are pretraining and warmup in English -- completely different engineering meanings.
samples.hypothesis: "Pre-training" and "warmup" both contain the character "pre" in Chinese, but their engineering meanings are completely different.

samples.source: 解码线程卡在队列上时，冲刷一次缓冲区通常就能让流水线重新动起来。
samples.reference: When the decode thread stalls on the queue, flushing the buffer once usually gets the pipeline moving again.
samples.hypothesis: When the decoding thread gets stuck in the queue, flushing the buffer once usually allows the pipeline to resume operation.

samples.source: 背压信号要一路传到采集端，否则缓冲区会在无人察觉时溢出。
samples.reference: The backpressure signal has to reach the capture side, otherwise the buffer overflows without anyone noticing.
samples.hypothesis: The backpressure signal must be transmitted to the acquisition unit, otherwise the buffer will overflow unnoticed.

samples.source: 把分块大小从 20 毫秒调到 40 毫秒，端到端延迟会上升但网络抖动的容忍度变好。
samples.reference: Raising the chunk size from 20 ms to 40 ms increases end-to-end latency but tolerates network jitter better.
samples.hypothesis: Adjusting the chunk size from 20 milliseconds to 40 milliseconds will increase the end-to-end delay, but the tolerance to network jitter improves.

samples.source: 数据流在中间层被复制两份时，要注意两份的帧序号不能各自递增。
samples.reference: When the data stream is duplicated in the middle layer, the frame numbering of both copies must not advance independently.
samples.hypothesis: When the data stream is duplicated twice in the intermediate layer, ensure that the frame numbers of the two copies do not increase individually.

samples.source: 流水线里任何一段引入线程池，都要重新检查语段结束事件的顺序保证。
samples.reference: Whenever a thread pool is introduced anywhere in the pipeline, the ordering guarantee of speech-segment end events must be rechecked.
samples.hypothesis: Any segment in the pipeline introduced into the thread pool must re-check the order of segment end events to ensure correctness.

samples.source: 队列长度是观测项，应该和首包延迟一起出现在诊断接口里。
samples.reference: Queue depth is an observable and should appear in the diagnostics endpoint next to time to first packet.
samples.hypothesis: The queue length is an observation item and should appear together with the first packet delay in the diagnostic interface.

samples.source: 流式识别在中途断线后，续传位置要以帧为单位记录而不是以秒为单位。
samples.reference: After streaming recognition is cut off mid-way, the resume position must be recorded in frames rather than in seconds.
samples.hypothesis: After the stream recognition is interrupted midway, the resume position should be recorded in frames rather than seconds.

samples.source: 分块处理音频时，块边界要对齐到采样点，否则会在交界处产生咔哒声。
samples.reference: When audio is processed in chunks, block boundaries must align to samples, or clicks appear at the seams.
samples.hypothesis: When processing audio in chunks, the block boundaries should be aligned with the sample points, otherwise a click sound will occur at the junction.

samples.source: 缓冲策略要显式声明是丢弃最旧还是阻塞生产者，两者语义完全不同。
samples.reference: The buffering policy must state whether it drops the oldest frame or blocks the producer; the two semantics differ completely.
samples.hypothesis: The buffering strategy should explicitly state whether to discard the oldest or block the producer; the semantics of the two are completely different.

samples.source: 流水线在关闭前要先冲刷所有阶段，否则最后一个语段会静默消失。
samples.reference: The pipeline has to flush every stage before shutdown, otherwise the final speech segment disappears without a trace.
samples.hypothesis: Before the pipeline is shut down, all stages must be flushed first, otherwise the last segment will silently disappear.

samples.source: 运行时把解码器放在工作线程上，界面线程只负责时间轴刷新。
samples.reference: The runtime puts the decoder on a worker thread, leaving the UI thread to only refresh the timeline.
samples.hypothesis: During runtime, the decoder is placed on the work thread, and the interface thread is responsible for updating the timeline.

samples.source: 每帧都重建特征维度的数组会造成明显垃圾回收压力，应当复用缓冲。
samples.reference: Rebuilding the feature-dimension array every frame causes noticeable garbage-collection pressure; reuse the buffer instead.
samples.hypothesis: Reconstructing an array of feature dimensions per frame causes significant garbage collection pressure; the buffer should be reused.

samples.source: 推理服务的并发上限应当与队列长度一起上报，便于运维判断排队规模。
samples.reference: An inference service should report its concurrency limit together with queue depth so operators can judge how long the line is.
samples.hypothesis: The concurrent limit of the reasoning service should be reported along with the queue length, facilitating operation and maintenance in assessing the queue size.

samples.source: 流式传输的重连策略要区分服务端主动关闭与网络抖动两种情况。
samples.reference: The reconnect policy for streaming transport must separate a server-initiated close from network jitter.
samples.hypothesis: The reconnection strategy for streaming should differentiate between the server actively closing and network fluctuations.

samples.source: 语音分段的边界判定依赖帧移设置，改帧移会同时改变分段粒度。
samples.reference: Segmentation boundaries in voice segmentation depend on the frame shift; changing it also changes segment granularity.
samples.hypothesis: The boundary determination for speech segmentation depends on the frame offset setting, and changing the frame offset will also affect the segmentation granularity.

samples.source: 缓冲区水位线要能同时约束延迟与丢帧率，只设上限是不够的。
samples.reference: A buffer watermark has to bound latency and frame loss together; an upper limit alone is not enough.
samples.hypothesis: The buffer water level line should simultaneously constrain both latency and frame loss rate; setting only an upper limit is insufficient.

samples.source: 当解码速度低于采集速度时，背压会把等待时间转移到编码器队列上。
samples.reference: When decoding runs slower than capture, backpressure shifts the waiting onto the encoder queue.
samples.hypothesis: When the decoding speed is lower than the acquisition speed, the backpressure will transfer the waiting time to the encoder queue.

samples.source: 检查点加载完成后要先做一次预热推理，再接受第一个请求。
samples.reference: After a checkpoint is loaded, run one warm-up inference before accepting the first request.
samples.hypothesis: After the checkpoint loading is complete, a preheating inference must be performed before accepting the first request.

samples.source: 流水线阶段的日志要带上语段编号，否则跨段问题无法归因。
samples.reference: Log lines for each pipeline stage should carry the speech-segment id, or cross-segment issues cannot be attributed.
samples.hypothesis: The logs for each pipeline stage should include the segment number, otherwise cross-stage issues cannot be attributed.

samples.source: 模型权重热更新时要冻结当前队列，等所有在飞请求结束后再替换。
samples.reference: Hot-swapping model weights must freeze the queue and wait for in-flight requests before the replacement.
samples.hypothesis: When updating model weights, the current queue is frozen and replaced after all active requests are completed.

samples.source: 词元数量超限的长文档要按段落切分喂入，而不是整段截断。
samples.reference: Long documents that exceed the token limit must be fed paragraph by paragraph rather than truncated as a whole.
samples.hypothesis: Long documents with excessive token count should be fed in by segmenting into paragraphs, rather than truncating the entire paragraph.

samples.source: 子词切分语言的重试策略要按词元计费上限设计，而非按句子数量。
samples.reference: Retry limits for subword-segmented languages should be designed around the token budget, not a sentence count.
samples.hypothesis: The retry strategy for subword segmentation of the language should be designed based on the upper limit of token billing, rather than the number of sentences.

samples.source: 运行时提供两个内存池，一个给帧缓冲，一个给特征张量。
samples.reference: The runtime offers two memory pools, one for the frame buffer and one for feature tensors.
samples.hypothesis: Two memory pools are provided during runtime, one for frame buffers and one for feature tensors.

samples.source: 分块边界与强制对齐的时间戳要对齐到同一采样点基准。
samples.reference: Chunk boundaries and forced-alignment timestamps must share one sample-based reference.
samples.hypothesis: The block boundaries and forced alignment timestamps should be aligned at the same sampling point reference.

samples.source: 流式合成输出的第一段要包含完整帧，播放器才不会在开头消音。
samples.reference: The first block emitted by streaming synthesis must contain whole frames, or the player goes silent at the start.
samples.hypothesis: The first segment of the stream synthesis output must contain a complete frame so that the player will not mute at the beginning.

samples.source: 队列满时的丢弃策略要写进响应说明，不能让调用方以为全部处理完成。
samples.reference: If a full queue causes drops, say so in the response instead of letting the caller believe everything was processed.
samples.hypothesis: The discard policy when the queue is full should be included in the response description, so that the caller doesn't assume that all processing is complete.

samples.source: 解码器输出的声道顺序要与容器声明一致，左右声道颠倒很难被听见。
samples.reference: The decoder's channel order must match the container's declaration; swapped stereo channels are hard to hear.
samples.hypothesis: The channel order of the decoder output must match that of the container declaration; reversing the left and right channels makes it difficult to hear.

samples.source: 端到端评测要按阶段拆开计时，采集到推理的间隔常常被忽略。
samples.reference: End-to-end evaluation should time each stage; the gap between capture and inference is often overlooked.
samples.hypothesis: The end-to-end evaluation should be time-based by stages, and the interval between data collection and inference is often overlooked.

samples.source: 推理线程绑核能减少抖动，但会让队列在单核机器上更容易积压。
samples.reference: Pinning inference threads reduces jitter but lets the queue build up more easily on single-core machines.
samples.hypothesis: The binding of inference threads to nuclear energy reduces jitter, but it makes the queue more prone to backlog on single-core machines.

samples.source: 帧缓冲的容量按秒换算时，要用采样率与特征维度共同决定。
samples.reference: Converting the frame buffer from seconds to bytes needs both the sample rate and the feature dimension.
samples.hypothesis: The capacity of the frame buffer, when converted per second, is determined by both the sampling rate and the feature dimension.

samples.source: 数据流合并后要重新编号，否则下游无法判断哪个语段先结束。
samples.reference: Merged data streams require renumbering, or downstream stages cannot tell which speech segment ends first.
samples.hypothesis: After the data flow merging, it needs to be renumbered, otherwise downstream nodes cannot determine which segment ends first.

samples.source: 冲刷操作必须是幂等的，重复调用不能把队列清空两次。
samples.reference: A flush must be idempotent; calling it twice must not empty the queue twice.
samples.hypothesis: The flushing operation must be idempotent; repeated calls should not clear the queue twice.

samples.source: 流水线监控至少要暴露各阶段队列长度与最老请求等待时间。
samples.reference: Pipeline monitoring should expose per-stage queue depth and the age of the oldest request.
samples.hypothesis: The pipeline monitoring should at least reveal the queue length at each stage and the waiting time of the oldest request.

samples.source: 语言代码在内部一律用规范形式，展示层再本地化，避免比较分叉。
samples.reference: Language codes stay canonical internally and are localized only at display time, to avoid comparison forks.
samples.hypothesis: Language codes should be standardized internally, and localization should be applied to the presentation layer to avoid divergence in comparisons.

samples.source: 自动语音识别与翻译阶段共享同一个词表缓存，能省下重复初始化。
samples.reference: Sharing one vocabulary cache between automatic speech recognition and translation saves repeated initialization.
samples.hypothesis: The automatic speech recognition and translation stage share the same vocabulary cache, which saves the need for repeated initialization.

samples.source: 语音闭环里任何一段改成异步，都要重新定义首段可播的测量点。
samples.reference: If any stage of the speech loop becomes asynchronous, redefine where time to first playable segment is measured.
samples.hypothesis: Any segment in the voice closed loop converted to asynchronous must redefine the initial measurable point for playback.

samples.source: 缓冲区的目标水位应当随网络抖动的历史分布自适应调整。
samples.reference: A buffer's target watermark should adapt to the historical distribution of network jitter.
samples.hypothesis: The target water level of the buffer should be adjusted adaptively according to the historical distribution of network jitter.

samples.source: 分块处理的窗口重叠长度会影响频谱估计的稳定度。
samples.reference: The overlap length of chunked processing affects the stability of the spectrum estimate.
samples.hypothesis: The overlap length of the blocks processed affects the stability of spectral estimation.

samples.source: 背压在跨进程边界上会失真，需要显式传递等待原因而不是靠超时推断。
samples.reference: Backpressure loses fidelity across a process boundary, so pass the waiting reason explicitly rather than inferring it from timeouts.
samples.hypothesis: Back pressure at the cross-process boundary causes distortion; the reason for waiting needs to be explicitly conveyed instead of inferred through timeout.

samples.source: 检查点切换要保留旧实例直到最后一个请求返回。
samples.reference: On a checkpoint switch, keep the old instance alive until the last request has returned.
samples.hypothesis: The checkpoint switch should retain the old instance until the last request is returned.

samples.source: 流水线的排队等待不计入推理耗时，否则延迟报表会被误读。
samples.reference: Queueing ahead of the pipeline must not count as inference time, or latency reports become misleading.
samples.hypothesis: Queueing at the production line does not count towards推理 time consumption, otherwise the latency report will be misinterpreted.

samples.source: 帧长为 25 毫秒、帧移为 10 毫秒时，一帧对应三个采样点窗口。
samples.reference: With a 25 ms frame length and a 10 ms frame shift, one frame spans three sample windows.
samples.hypothesis: When the frame length is 25 milliseconds and the frame offset is 10 milliseconds, one frame corresponds to a window of three sampling points.

samples.source: 队列的等待上限必须有硬边界，超过平台表示范围会直接抛错。
samples.reference: A queue wait limit needs a hard ceiling; past the platform's representable range it raises instead of waiting.
samples.hypothesis: The maximum waiting limit for the queue must have a hard boundary; exceeding the range will cause an error.

samples.source: 推理阶段的批大小上限要与显存水位联动，固定值在共享机器上不稳。
samples.reference: The inference batch cap should follow the memory watermark; a fixed value is unstable on shared machines.
samples.hypothesis: The upper limit of batch size during the inference phase should be linked to the VRAM level, and the fixed value is unstable on shared machines.

samples.source: 解码器输出的时间戳精度到毫秒即可，字幕文件不需要厘秒。
samples.reference: Millisecond timestamps from the decoder are enough; subtitle files do not need centiseconds.
samples.hypothesis: The timestamp output by the decoder should be accurate to milliseconds, and the subtitle file does not require even a fraction of a second.

samples.source: 流式识别的部分结果要标注是否可回退，供下游决定是否上屏。
samples.reference: Partial results from streaming recognition should say whether they can be revised, so downstream can decide to show them.
samples.hypothesis: Some results of the stream recognition should be marked as whether they can be rolled back, for the downstream to decide whether to display on the screen.

samples.source: 语音分段结果与说话人分离结果合并时，段边界可能不一致需要仲裁。
samples.reference: Merging voice segmentation with speaker diarization can disagree on boundaries and needs arbitration.
samples.hypothesis: When combining speech segment results and speaker separation results, the segment boundaries may be inconsistent and require arbitration.

samples.source: 运行时退出前要打印各阶段缓冲剩余量，便于事后判断是否丢数据。
samples.reference: On shutdown the runtime should print what each buffer still holds, to tell later whether data was dropped.
samples.hypothesis: Before exiting during operation, print the remaining amount of buffer for each stage to facilitate later judgment on whether data was lost.

samples.source: 队列超时后仍要继续消费，避免恢复瞬间被积压请求淹没。
samples.reference: Keep draining after a queue timeout, so a flood of backlogged requests does not overwhelm the restart.
samples.hypothesis: Continue consuming even after queue timeout to avoid being overwhelmed by backlog requests during recovery.

samples.source: 流水线里共享的可变状态要用消息传递替代锁，否则阶段顺序一变就死锁。
samples.reference: Replace locks with message passing for shared mutable state in a pipeline; a stage reorder otherwise deadlocks.
samples.hypothesis: The variable states shared in the pipeline should be replaced by message passing instead of locks, otherwise deadlock will occur as soon as the stage order changes.

samples.source: 首包延迟与首段可播是两个量，不能混用同一个指标名。
samples.reference: Time to first packet and time to first playable segment are different measurements and must not share one metric name.
samples.hypothesis: First packet delay and first segment playability are two different metrics, and cannot use the same metric name.

samples.source: 词元预算接近上限时，优先裁剪历史示例而不是术语表。
samples.reference: Near the token budget, trim the few-shot examples before the terminology list.
samples.hypothesis: When the element budget approaches the upper limit, prioritize trimming historical examples rather than the glossary.

samples.source: 分块下载的音频要先做采样率一致性校验再送入识别。
samples.reference: Chunk-downloaded audio needs a sample-rate consistency check before recognition.
samples.hypothesis: The audio downloaded in chunks needs to undergo a sample rate consistency check before being sent for recognition.

samples.source: 缓冲区预取过多会让最后一个语段等待时间变长。
samples.reference: Over-prefetching in the buffer lengthens how long the final speech segment waits.
samples.hypothesis: Too much buffer prefetching will prolong the waiting time for the last segment.

samples.source: 流式传输的序号回绕要在协议层定义清楚，不能靠实现默契。
samples.reference: Sequence wrap-around in streaming transport must be defined by the protocol, not left to implementation habit.
samples.hypothesis: The sequence wrapping for streaming transmission should be clearly defined at the protocol level, not relied on mutual understanding in implementation.

samples.source: 解码器遇到损坏帧时应当输出静音帧并记录原因，而不是直接抛异常。
samples.reference: On a corrupt frame the decoder should emit silence and record the reason rather than raising.
samples.hypothesis: The decoder should output a mute frame when encountering a corrupted frame and record the reason, rather than throwing an exception.

samples.source: 推理结果缓存以语言对与领域共同定键，跨领域复用会错配语境。
samples.reference: The inference result cache is keyed by language pair and domain together; reusing across domains mismatches context.
samples.hypothesis: The reasoning result cache is keyed by language pair and domain, and cross-domain reuse would result in context mismatch.

samples.source: 流水线的每一段都要能单独降级，而不是整体失败。
samples.reference: Each stage of the pipeline needs its own degradation path instead of failing as a whole.
samples.hypothesis: Each segment of the production line should be able to be downgraded individually, rather than failing as a whole.

samples.source: 运行时指标里排队时长与处理时长分开统计，运维才知道该扩容哪一段。
samples.reference: Separate queueing time from processing time in runtime metrics so operators know which stage to scale.
samples.hypothesis: In runtime metrics, the queue time and processing time are counted separately, allowing operations team to determine which section needs expansion.

samples.source: 音频归一化要放在编码之前做，动态范围才不会被压缩吃掉。
samples.reference: Do audio normalization before encoding, or the dynamic range gets compressed away.
samples.hypothesis: Audio normalization should be performed before encoding to prevent the dynamic range from being compressed.

samples.source: 转码任务按片段粒度断点续跑，失败时不必从头重来。
samples.reference: Transcoding jobs resume per segment, so a failure does not restart the whole file.
samples.hypothesis: The transcoding task continues from where it left off at segment level, and there's no need to start over when it fails.

samples.source: 码率控制选择恒定质量时，关键帧间隔会随之浮动而非固定。
samples.reference: Constant-quality rate control lets the keyframe interval float instead of staying fixed.
samples.hypothesis: When constant quality is selected for bitrate control, the interval between keyframes will fluctuate rather than remain fixed.

samples.source: 容器格式的时间戳基准是媒体时间，换算成墙钟需要轨道起始偏移。
samples.reference: A container format stamps media time, so wall-clock conversion needs the track's start offset.
samples.hypothesis: The timestamp reference for container format is the media time, and to convert it into wall clock time, a track offset is required.

samples.source: 复用器要求两条轨道的采样点对齐，否则会插入填充包。
samples.reference: The multiplexer demands sample-aligned tracks, or it inserts filler packets.
samples.hypothesis: The multiplexer requires the sampling points of the two tracks to be aligned; otherwise, padding packets will be inserted.

samples.source: 解码器的错误隐藏强度是可配置项，过高会让损坏音频听起来平滑但失真。
samples.reference: Decoder error concealment is configurable; too much makes damaged audio smooth but wrong.
samples.hypothesis: The error hiding strength of the decoder is a configurable parameter; too high will make damaged audio sound smooth but distorted.

samples.source: 图像组长度与随机接入点共同决定快进快退的响应速度。
samples.reference: The group of pictures length and the random access points decide how responsive seeking is.
samples.hypothesis: The group size of the image and the random access point jointly determine the response speed of fast forward and fast back.

samples.source: 帧间预测依赖参考帧顺序，丢帧后必须请求新的同步点。
samples.reference: Inter-frame prediction depends on reference order, so a lost frame must trigger a fresh sync point.
samples.hypothesis: Inter-frame prediction depends on the reference frame order, and a frame loss requires a new synchronization point.

samples.source: 量化参数越高压缩率越高，但文字边缘的块效应会先进入可见范围。
samples.reference: A higher quantization parameter compresses more, but blocking artifacts on text edges become visible first.
samples.hypothesis: The higher the quantization parameter, the higher the compression ratio, but the block effect at the text edges will first enter the visible range.

samples.source: 熵编码的上下文表要在流开始时重置，跨片段复用会造成漂移。
samples.reference: The entropy coding context table must reset at stream start; reusing it across segments causes drift.
samples.hypothesis: The context table for entropy coding needs to be reset at the start of the stream, and segment-level reuse can cause drift.

samples.source: 转码链路里保持原始采样点总数不变，重采样只在显式请求时启用。
samples.reference: A transcoding chain keeps the original sample count unless resampling is explicitly requested.
samples.hypothesis: The total number of original sampling points remains unchanged in the transcoding link, and resampling is enabled only upon explicit request.

samples.source: 无损压缩只保证比特一致，不保证人耳听到的主观质量提升。
samples.reference: Lossless compression guarantees identical bits, not a better subjective quality.
samples.hypothesis: Lossless compression only ensures bit consistency, not a subjective improvement in the quality heard by the ear.

samples.source: 有损压缩在低码率下会优先牺牲高频细节而非语音基频。
samples.reference: At low bitrate, lossy compression sacrifices high-frequency detail before the voice fundamental.
samples.hypothesis: Lossy compression sacrifices high-frequency details over the speech fundamental frequencies at low bitrate.

samples.source: 解复用器遇到交错写入的轨道时要按解码顺序输出样本。
samples.reference: A demuxer must emit samples in decode order when tracks were interleaved on write.
samples.hypothesis: The demultiplexer outputs samples in the decoding order when encountering interleaved tracks.

samples.source: 比特率探测窗口过短会把静止画面误判成可以降到极低码率。
samples.reference: A bitrate estimation window that is too short mistakes a still frame for something expendable.
samples.hypothesis: The bitrate probing window being too short will misjudge still images as being able to reduce to an extremely low bitrate.

samples.source: 编解码器协商失败时必须落回双方共同支持的最低配置。
samples.reference: Negotiation between codecs must fall back to the lowest configuration both sides support.
samples.hypothesis: The codec negotiation fails and must revert to the lowest configuration supported by both parties.

samples.source: 容器格式对轨道数量的限制会在多字幕语言时先撞上。
samples.reference: Container format limits on track count are hit first when many subtitle languages are bundled.
samples.hypothesis: The restriction on the container format for the number of tracks will conflict with multi-subtitle languages.

samples.source: 关键帧间隔超过两秒时，直播场景的拖动预览会明显迟钝。
samples.reference: Keyframe intervals beyond two seconds make scrubbing previews sluggish in live scenarios.
samples.hypothesis: When the interval between keyframes exceeds two seconds, the drag preview in a live broadcast scene becomes significantly slow.

samples.source: 运动估计的搜索范围增大并不总能提升质量，却一定增加编码耗时。
samples.reference: Widening the motion estimation search rarely improves quality and always costs encoding time.
samples.hypothesis: The increased search range for motion estimation does not always improve quality, but certainly increases encoding time.

samples.source: 帧内预测在静止画面上的收益高于帧间预测，但码率也随之上升。
samples.reference: Intra-frame prediction pays off on still imagery more than inter-frame, though the bitrate rises.
samples.hypothesis: Intra-prediction offers better performance on still images than inter-prediction, but the bitrate also increases.

samples.source: 编码器输出的容器头信息应当与素材真实声道数一致，不能沿用模板。
samples.reference: The container header an encoder writes must match the real channel count, not the template's.
samples.hypothesis: The container header information output by the encoder should match the actual number of audio channels of the material, and the template cannot be used.

samples.source: 转码前的媒体探针结果要落盘，事后核对声道与位深变化。
samples.reference: Save the probe result before transcoding, to check channel and bit-depth changes afterwards.
samples.hypothesis: The media probe results before transcoding should be recorded, and the channel and depth changes should be checked later.

samples.source: 多进程转码时每个进程独立持有缓冲，禁止共享帧缓冲内存。
samples.reference: In multi-process transcoding each process owns its buffer; sharing frame buffer memory is forbidden.
samples.hypothesis: During multi-process transcoding, each process independently holds a buffer, and sharing of frame buffer memory is prohibited.

samples.source: 解码顺序与显示顺序不同的轨道必须由容器显式记录偏移。
samples.reference: Tracks whose decode order differs from display order need an explicit container offset.
samples.hypothesis: Tracks with a different decoding order than the display order must have the offset explicitly recorded by the container.

samples.source: 码率控制对旁白静音段的分配应当低于同期对白，而非均分。
samples.reference: Rate control should allocate less to narration silence than to the speech in the same passage.
samples.hypothesis: The bitrate control for the voice-off segments should be lower than that of the dialogue, rather than evenly distributed.

samples.source: 熵解码错误在关键帧之后才可恢复，静音期不能替代同步点。
samples.reference: Entropy decoding errors recover only at a keyframe; silence is not a sync point.
samples.hypothesis: The entropy decoding error can only be restored after key frames, and silence periods cannot replace synchronization points.

samples.source: GOP 首帧必须是可独立解码帧，否则切片工具会在段首花屏。
samples.reference: The first frame of a group of pictures must be independently decodable, or segmenting tools show corruption.
samples.hypothesis: The first frame of GOP must be a independently decodable frame; otherwise, the slicing tool will cause a screen glitch at the beginning of the segment.

samples.source: 容器格式的元数据字段长度限制会影响双语字幕的轨道命名。
samples.reference: A container format's metadata length limits affect how bilingual subtitle tracks are named.
samples.hypothesis: The length limit of metadata fields in container format affects the track naming of bilingual subtitles.

samples.source: 编码器对字幕轨只做透传时，也要保留原始时间轴精度。
samples.reference: Pass-through of a subtitle track must still preserve the original timeline precision.
samples.hypothesis: When the encoder only performs transparent transmission for the subtitles track, the original timeline precision should also be maintained.

samples.source: 转码并发改多了会让磁盘随机写成为瓶颈，而非 CPU。
samples.reference: Too much transcoding concurrency makes random disk writes the bottleneck rather than the CPU.
samples.hypothesis: Too many concurrent transcoding and modifications will make random disk writes a bottleneck, not the CPU.

samples.source: 双语字幕的每一行都要各自满足阅读速度上限，不能只看中文一行。
samples.reference: Each line of a bilingual subtitle has to meet the reading-speed bound on its own, not just the Chinese one.
samples.hypothesis: Each line of the bilingual subtitle must meet the upper limit of reading speed, and not just one line in Chinese.

samples.source: 硬字幕烧进画面后只能靠重新编码修改，软字幕可以随时替换轨道。
samples.reference: Hard subtitles can only be changed by re-encoding, while soft subtitles let you swap the track at any time.
samples.hypothesis: After the hard subtitles burn into the screen, only re-encoding can be used to modify them, while soft subtitles can be replaced at any time.

samples.source: 字幕轨的字符编码要在容器里显式声明，否则播放器会按本地默认码页猜。
samples.reference: The subtitle track's encoding must be declared in the container, or the player guesses from the local code page.
samples.hypothesis: The character encoding of the subtitles track must be explicitly declared in the container; otherwise, the player will guess based on the local default code page.

samples.source: 配音替换的是音轨而不是时长，压缩时长会破坏声画同步。
samples.reference: Dubbing replaces the audio track, not the duration; squeezing the duration breaks audio-video sync.
samples.hypothesis: The dub replaces the audio track rather than the duration, and compressing the duration would disrupt the audio-video synchronization.

samples.source: 旁白的语速通常低于对白，配音时不能沿用同一套时间轴策略。
samples.reference: Narration is slower paced than dialogue, so dubbing cannot reuse the same timeline strategy.
samples.hypothesis: The speech rate is usually lower than the dialogue, and the same timeline strategy cannot be used for dubbing.

samples.source: 对口型调整只能在帧级别微调，超过两帧就会看出违和。
samples.reference: Lip sync adjustment works only within a couple of frames; beyond that the mismatch becomes visible.
samples.hypothesis: Face matching can only be adjusted slightly at the frame level; beyond two frames, inconsistencies become apparent.

samples.source: 字幕时序的漂移通常累积在段落边界，而不是均匀分布在每行。
samples.reference: Subtitle timing drift accumulates at paragraph boundaries rather than spreading evenly across lines.
samples.hypothesis: The drift in subtitle timing usually accumulates at paragraph boundaries, rather than being evenly distributed across each line.

samples.source: 字幕对齐要先按语音分段切点，再把文字映射到段边界。
samples.reference: Subtitle alignment should cut points by voice segmentation first, then map text onto those boundaries.
samples.hypothesis: The subtitle alignment requires first segmenting the speech into segments, and then mapping the text to the segment boundaries.

samples.source: 分段计时要以素材的时间轴为基准，转码后不能假设毫秒值不变。
samples.reference: Segment timing must be based on the media timeline; do not assume millisecond values survive transcoding.
samples.hypothesis: The segmenting timing should be based on the material's timeline, and it cannot assume that the millisecond values remain constant after transcoding.

samples.source: 字幕文件导入时若带字节顺序标记，要识别并剥除，否则首行字幕会带上不可见字符。
samples.reference: Detect and strip a byte order mark on subtitle import, or the first line carries an invisible character.
samples.hypothesis: When importing subtitle files with byte order mark, it must be identified and removed, otherwise the first line of subtitles will contain invisible characters.

samples.source: 配音与对口型的验收标准不同，前者听语音替换，后者看画面同步。
samples.reference: Dubbing and lip sync have different acceptance criteria: one is judged by the replaced voice, the other by the picture.
samples.hypothesis: The acceptance criteria for dubbing and lip-syncing are different; the former involves listening to voice replacement, while the latter involves visual synchronization.

samples.source: 多语种字幕发布时，字幕轨语言要用语言代码而不是显示名。
samples.reference: Multi-language subtitle releases should key subtitle tracks by language code, not display name.
samples.hypothesis: When releasing multilingual subtitles, the subtitle track language should use the language code instead of the display name.

samples.source: 字幕行的换行位置要在渲染端决定，导出选项与之解耦。
samples.reference: Line breaking for subtitles belongs to the renderer, decoupled from export options.
samples.hypothesis: The line break position of the subtitle line should be determined at the rendering stage, and the export options are decoupled from it.

samples.source: 时间轴面板要区分视频帧号与音频采样点号，两者换算依赖帧率与采样率。
samples.reference: A timeline panel must separate video frame numbers from audio sample indices; conversion depends on frame rate and sample rate.
samples.hypothesis: The timeline panel should differentiate between video frame numbers and audio sample points, and the conversion between them depends on the frame rate and sampling rate.

samples.source: 配音音轨的响度归一化目标要与原对白一致，否则切换时音量跳变。
samples.reference: The loudness target of a dubbed audio track must match the original or the level jumps when switching.
samples.hypothesis: The loudness normalization target of the voiceover track should be consistent with the original dialogue, otherwise there will be a volume jump during switching.

samples.source: 字幕时序在变速播放下需要重新映射，倍速不是简单缩放时间戳。
samples.reference: Subtitle timing needs remapping under variable playback speed; scaling timestamps is not enough.
samples.hypothesis: The subtitle timing needs to be remapped under variable speed playback, and speed up is not simply scaling the timestamp.

samples.source: 导出为 SRT 时时间戳精确到毫秒即可，ASS 需要到厘秒。
samples.reference: Export to SRT needs millisecond timestamps while ASS needs centiseconds.
samples.hypothesis: When exporting to SRT, the timestamp should be accurate to milliseconds; ASS requires sub-millisecond precision.

samples.source: 预览窗口按软字幕渲染，让用户能开关字幕轨。
samples.reference: The preview renders soft subtitles so users can toggle the subtitle track.
samples.hypothesis: The preview window renders in soft subtitles, allowing users to turn the subtitles on and off.

samples.source: 剪辑导出时若只改时间轴不改内容，重新封装就够，不要引入不必要的二压。
samples.reference: Re-muxing is enough when only the timeline changes; do not add an unnecessary second lossy compression pass.
samples.hypothesis: When editing and exporting, if only the timeline is changed without any content changes, re-packaging is sufficient; avoid introducing unnecessary secondary compression.

samples.source: 配音项目的交付要同时给音轨与双语字幕，缺一项就无法复核。
samples.reference: A dubbing delivery needs both the audio track and bilingual subtitles, or the work cannot be reviewed.
samples.hypothesis: The delivery of the voiceover project must include both audio tracks and bilingual subtitles; neither item can be reviewed without the other.

samples.source: 字幕断句要避开词中间，中文按语段、拉丁文按词边界处理。
samples.reference: Subtitle line breaking must avoid cutting inside words: Chinese by speech segment, Latin scripts by word boundary.
samples.hypothesis: Subtitles should avoid the middle of words, handling Chinese by sentence segments and Latin by word boundaries.

samples.source: 音轨对齐检查可以在无配音情况下先做，不必等全部素材到位。
samples.reference: Timeline alignment checks can run before dubbing, without waiting for all assets.
samples.hypothesis: Track alignment check can be performed without voiceover, without waiting for all materials to be in place.

samples.source: 台词删改会移动后续时间轴，需要整段重排而不是逐行挪。
samples.reference: Cutting a line shifts every later timestamp, so reflow the whole block rather than nudging rows.
samples.hypothesis: The line edits will shift the subsequent timeline, requiring a full rearrangement rather than moving each line individually.

samples.source: 配音演员的分段录音要保留采样率与位深一致，避免二次重采样。
samples.reference: Dubbing sessions must keep a consistent sample rate and bit depth to avoid a second resampling.
samples.hypothesis: The segment recordings of voice actors should maintain the same sample rate and bit depth to avoid secondary resampling.

samples.source: 字幕轨的最大字符数应按目标语言宽度实测，不按中文经验值套。
samples.reference: The maximum characters per subtitle line should be measured for the target language's width, not copied from Chinese habits.
samples.hypothesis: The maximum number of characters for the subtitles track should be measured based on the target language width, not based on Chinese experience values.

samples.source: 声画同步的容忍阈值要按素材类型定，会议录像与动画并不一样。
samples.reference: The audio-video sync tolerance depends on the material; conference recordings and animation differ.
samples.hypothesis: The tolerance threshold for audio-video synchronization should be determined based on the material type, as meeting videos and animations are different.

samples.source: 字幕的标点恢复要在分段之后做，跨段标点会错挂到相邻行。
samples.reference: Run punctuation restoration after segmentation, or punctuation crosses into neighbouring lines.
samples.hypothesis: The punctuation restoration of subtitles should be done after segmentation, as punctuation across segments may appear incorrectly in adjacent lines.

samples.source: 旁白与对白混在同一音轨时，配音替换需要按语段定位。
samples.reference: When narration and dialogue share one audio track, dubbing replacement must locate speech segments first.
samples.hypothesis: When the narration and dialogue are mixed in the same track, voice replacement requires positioning by segment.

samples.source: 导出前比对采样率、声道与位深三项，不匹配就提示并拒绝静默重采样。
samples.reference: Compare sample rate, channel count and bit depth before export, and refuse a silent resample when they differ.
samples.hypothesis: Before export, compare the sampling rate, channels, and bit depth; if they do not match, a warning will be given and silent resampling will be rejected.

samples.source: 字幕时序在缺帧素材上要按有效帧长插值，不能假设恒定帧率。
samples.reference: Subtitle timing on material with dropped frames must interpolate by real frame durations, not a constant rate.
samples.hypothesis: The subtitle timing should be interpolated based on the effective frame length on missing frames, and a constant frame rate cannot be assumed.

samples.source: 多角色播客的本地化要先做说话人分离，再按角色分配合成音色。
samples.reference: Multi-speaker podcast localization needs speaker diarization first, then timbre assignment per role.
samples.hypothesis: Localizing multi-character podcasts requires first separating the speakers, and then assigning different voices according to the characters.

samples.source: 配音的口型参考帧应在解码后取，编码前的帧序列不可靠。
samples.reference: Use decoded frames as the lip-sync reference; pre-encode frame order is unreliable.
samples.hypothesis: The voice shape reference frame for dubming should be taken after decoding, and the frame sequence before encoding is unreliable.

samples.source: 字幕轨嵌套富文本时，容器格式对标签白名单要写清。
samples.reference: When a subtitle track carries rich text, spell out the container's tag whitelist.
samples.hypothesis: When nesting subtitles with rich text, the container format should be clearly specified in the tag allowlist.

samples.source: 把内嵌字幕转成软字幕需要光学字符识别，质量会低于原始文本。
samples.reference: Converting hard subtitles into soft ones needs optical recognition, and quality drops below authored text.
samples.hypothesis: Converting embedded subtitles to soft subtitles requires optical character recognition, and the quality will be lower than the original text.

samples.source: 时长压缩到 95% 会累积成半秒偏移，长素材必须分段校正。
samples.reference: Squeezing duration to 95 percent accumulates into a half-second offset; long material needs segment-wise correction.
samples.hypothesis: The duration reduced to 95% will result in a half-second offset, and long footage must be corrected in segments.

samples.source: 配音交付要附时间轴文件与音轨两份产物，命名规则事先约定。
samples.reference: Dubbing delivery ships two artefacts, a timeline file and an audio track, with naming agreed in advance.
samples.hypothesis: The voice delivery should include two files: a timeline file and a audio track, with a pre-agreed naming convention.

samples.source: 字幕行长度与每屏行数共同决定阅读速度上限。
samples.reference: Line length and lines per screen together bound the readable speed of subtitles.
samples.hypothesis: The length of the subtitle lines and the number of lines per screen jointly determine the maximum reading speed.

samples.source: 同一素材的多语种字幕应共享分段结果，避免各自漂移。
samples.reference: Subtitle tracks in several languages should share one segmentation result to avoid drifting apart.
samples.hypothesis: Multilingual subtitles for the same material should share the segmentation results to avoid individual drift.

samples.source: 时间轴导出要显式声明参考是媒体时间还是墙钟时间。
samples.reference: Timeline export must state whether it references media time or wall-clock time.
samples.hypothesis: The time axis export should explicitly indicate whether it refers to media time or wall clock time.

samples.source: 配音的呼吸声保留与否要与原声一致，过度降噪会显得虚假。
samples.reference: Keep or remove dubbing breathes consistently with the source; over-cleaning sounds artificial.
samples.hypothesis: The retention or removal of the breathing sound in the voiceover should be consistent with the original sound; excessive noise reduction will make it seem fake.

samples.source: 字幕对齐失败时要报出对不上的语段编号，方便人工介入。
samples.reference: On alignment failure, report the speech segment ids that disagree so a human can step in.
samples.hypothesis: When subtitle alignment fails, indicate the numbers of the mismatched segments for manual intervention.

samples.source: 字幕轨与视频轨的起始偏移要各自记录，合并后无法反推。
samples.reference: Record the start offsets of subtitle and video tracks separately; they cannot be recovered after muxing.
samples.hypothesis: The starting offsets of the subtitle track and the video track should be recorded separately, and cannot be reversed after merging.

samples.source: 变速与变调要分别声明，只调其一时听感会不一致。
samples.reference: Declare speed and pitch changes separately; changing one alone sounds inconsistent.
samples.hypothesis: The speed and tone changes should be stated separately; adjusting only one will result in inconsistent sound.

samples.source: 对白密集的素材里，字幕分段应以停顿而不是标点为主判据。
samples.reference: In dialogue-dense material, break subtitles on pauses rather than punctuation.
samples.hypothesis: In materials with dense dialogue, the segmentation of subtitles should be based on pauses rather than punctuation as the criterion.

samples.source: 音轨替换后重新混流时，要保留原轨的语言标签与默认轨标记。
samples.reference: After swapping an audio track, preserve its language tag and default-track flag when re-muxing.
samples.hypothesis: When re-mixing after track replacement, the language tags and default track markers of the original track should be retained.

samples.source: 字幕时序校正要以可懂度为准，不为齐帧牺牲断句。
samples.reference: Let intelligibility rule subtitle timing fixes rather than aligning to frames.
samples.hypothesis: The subtitle timing correction should be based on readability, without sacrificing punctuation for frame alignment.

samples.source: 配音时长超出画面时，优先调整语速而不是删内容。
samples.reference: When a dubbing runs long against the picture, adjust pacing before cutting content.
samples.hypothesis: When the voiceover duration exceeds the frame, prioritize adjusting the speech rate rather than removing content.

samples.source: 把双语字幕上下排布会让每屏行数翻倍，需下调停留时间。
samples.reference: Stacking bilingual subtitles doubles lines per screen, so dwell time must shrink.
samples.hypothesis: Placing the dual-language subtitles vertically will double the number of lines per screen, requiring a reduction in the stay time.

samples.source: 字幕文件的时间戳若早于视频起始偏移，播放器会丢弃该行。
samples.reference: The player drops subtitle lines whose timestamps precede the video's start offset.
samples.hypothesis: If the timestamp in the subtitle file is earlier than the video start offset, the player will discard that line.

samples.source: 导出前检查相邻字幕重叠，重叠会让阅读者不知读哪一行。
samples.reference: Check for overlapping subtitles before export; overlap leaves the reader unsure which line to read.
samples.hypothesis: Check for overlapping adjacent subtitles before exporting; overlapping subtitles will make readers unsure which line to read.

samples.source: 配音演员的分段间隔要留静音余量，便于后期对齐。
samples.reference: Leave silence padding between dubbing takes to make later alignment possible.
samples.hypothesis: The segment intervals for voice actors should include a silence gap for easy alignment in later stages.

samples.source: 长视频的字幕分段建议按语义段落而不是固定秒数切。
samples.reference: Split subtitles for long video by semantic paragraphs rather than fixed seconds.
samples.hypothesis: It is recommended to segment the subtitles of long videos based on semantic segments rather than fixed seconds.

samples.source: 字幕时序导出为帧率非整数素材时，必须用时间基而不是帧计数。
samples.reference: For non-integer frame rates, export subtitle timing in a timebase instead of frame counts.
samples.hypothesis: When exporting subtitles sequence as non-integer frame rate material, a time base must be used instead of frame count.

samples.source: 音轨的响度目标要在混流前定，混完再压会牵连对白。
samples.reference: Set the loudness target before muxing; compressing afterwards also affects dialogue.
samples.hypothesis: The loudness target of the audio tracks should be determined before mixing, as mixing and pressing later will affect the dialogue.

samples.source: 字幕断行遇到缩写与专有名词要有保护规则，避免误断。
samples.reference: Line breaking needs protection rules for abbreviations and proper names.
samples.hypothesis: Subtitle line breaks should follow a protection rule for abbreviations and proper nouns to avoid misinterpretation.

samples.source: 对口型素材若帧率不一致，要先统一到时间轴基准。
samples.reference: Normalize differing frame rates onto one timeline before any lip-sync work.
samples.hypothesis: If the frame rate of the avatar materials is inconsistent, it should be standardized to the timeline baseline first.

samples.source: 字幕的省略号与破折号在语音合成里需要单独停顿规则。
samples.reference: Ellipses and dashes in subtitles need their own pause rules for speech synthesis.
samples.hypothesis: The ellipsis and dash symbols in subtitles require separate pause rules in speech synthesis.

samples.source: 配音质检要按语段回放，整片一次过会漏掉局部不同步。
samples.reference: Review dubbing speech segment by segment; one pass over the whole show misses local desync.
samples.hypothesis: Voiceover quality inspection should be carried out by replaying the segments, and a single pass for the entire piece may result in missing local inconsistencies.

samples.source: 多语言交付里，字幕文件命名要含语言代码与来源标记。
samples.reference: In multilingual delivery, subtitle filenames carry the language code and provenance.
samples.hypothesis: In multi-language delivery, the subtitle file names should include the language code and source marker.

samples.source: 时间轴导出要包含轨道偏移与有效帧率两项元数据。
samples.reference: Timeline export must include track offsets and the effective frame rate.
samples.hypothesis: The timeline export should include two metadata items: track offset and effective frame rate.

samples.source: 字幕行的停留时长下限由字数决定，不由切换节奏决定。
samples.reference: A subtitle line's minimum dwell time is set by its length, not by cut rhythm.
samples.hypothesis: The minimum duration for a subtitle line pause is determined by the number of characters, not by the switching rhythm.

samples.source: 旁白与配乐同轨时，配音替换需要额外的分离步骤。
samples.reference: When narration shares a track with music, dubbing needs an extra separation step.
samples.hypothesis: When the narration and music are synchronized, additional separation steps are required for voice replacement.

samples.source: 字幕轨的字符集要在导出日志里记录，供现场排障。
samples.reference: Record the subtitle track's character set in the export log for field debugging.
samples.hypothesis: The character set of the subtitle track should be recorded in the export log for on-site troubleshooting.

samples.source: 声画同步测量要用人耳可辨的事件点，例如掌声与敲击。
samples.reference: Measure audio-video sync on audible events such as claps and strikes.
samples.hypothesis: Sonic-video synchronized measurement should use event points that can be recognized by the human ear, such as applause and tapping.

samples.source: 字幕对齐的人工抽检要覆盖首尾与中途，长素材中段最容易漂。
samples.reference: Spot-check subtitle alignment at the start, middle and end; the middle drifts most.
samples.hypothesis: Manual spot checks for subtitle alignment should cover both the beginning, end, and middle, as the middle part of long materials is prone to misalignment.

samples.source: 配音要按目标语言重排断句，直译长度常常超出画面。
samples.reference: Dubbing must re-break lines for the target language; literal length usually exceeds the picture.
samples.hypothesis: The voiceover needs to be reassembled and restructured according to the target language, and literal translation often exceeds the frame length.

samples.source: 字幕时序在丢帧素材上要记录丢帧位置，否则校正无据。
samples.reference: Log dropped-frame positions on subtitle timelines, or corrections have no basis.
samples.hypothesis: The subtitle timing should record the frame loss position on the frame-loss material, otherwise the correction will be meaningless.

samples.source: 多轨合并时默认轨与强制轨标记要显式写入，不靠播放器猜。
samples.reference: Write default and forced track flags explicitly when merging tracks.
samples.hypothesis: When merging multiple tracks, the default track and forced track markers must be explicitly written, rather than relying on the player to guess.

samples.source: 导出双语字幕时，两种语言的停留时长要共同满足阅读速度约束。
samples.reference: When exporting bilingual subtitles, dwell time must satisfy one reading-speed bound for both languages.
samples.hypothesis: When exporting dual-language subtitles, the duration of each language must meet the reading speed constraints together.

samples.source: 缓冲不足会让字幕渲染出现整行闪烁，与内容无关。
samples.reference: Underrun in the buffer makes whole subtitle lines flicker, independent of content.
samples.hypothesis: Insufficient buffering causes the subtitles to flicker across entire lines, which has nothing to do with the content.

samples.source: 分段计时表要能导出为对照清单，供配音现场按行取用。
samples.reference: Export the segment timing sheet as a checklist dubbing sessions can follow line by line.
samples.hypothesis: The segment timing sheet should be able to export to a checklist for use on the voiceover scene line by line.

samples.source: 时间轴上的静默段也要保留编号，删除会造成后续错位。
samples.reference: Keep numbering for silent spans on the timeline; deleting one shifts everything after it.
samples.hypothesis: The silent segments on the time axis should also be retained with numbers; deletion would cause misalignment in subsequent sequences.

samples.source: 音轨替换要同步替换时长元数据，只换负载会留下错长度。
samples.reference: Replacing an audio track must update its duration metadata, not just the payload.
samples.hypothesis: The audio track replacement should synchronize with the duration metadata; changing only the load will result in incorrect length.

samples.source: 缓存命中率高不等于翻译质量好，缓存只说明这句话以前见过。
samples.reference: A high cache hit rate does not mean good translation quality; it only means the sentence was seen before.
samples.hypothesis: High cache hit rate does not equal good translation quality; caching only indicates that this sentence has been seen before.

samples.source: 这里的缓存指的是音频帧缓存，不要译成网页缓存。
samples.reference: The cache here is the audio frame cache, not a web cache.
samples.hypothesis: The cache here refers to audio frame cache.

samples.source: 预取缓存开太大时，最后一个语段的等待时间反而变长。
samples.reference: An over-large prefetch cache lengthens how long the last speech segment waits.
samples.hypothesis: When the prefetch cache is too large, the waiting time of the last segment becomes longer.

samples.source: 磁盘缓存在断电后仍然有效，所以失效策略要写清版本标识。
samples.reference: A disk cache survives power loss, so its invalidation policy needs a version tag.
samples.hypothesis: Disk caching remains effective after power off, so the failure policy should include a version identifier.

samples.source: 缓存键必须含语言对与领域，否则跨领域复用会错配语境。
samples.reference: A cache key must include the language pair and domain, or cross-domain reuse mismatches context.
samples.hypothesis: The cache key must include the language pair and domain; otherwise, cross-domain reuse will result in a mismatch in context.

samples.source: 编解码器升级后旧码流仍能解码，兼容矩阵要写进发布说明。
samples.reference: After a codec upgrade old streams still decode, and the compatibility matrix belongs in the release notes.
samples.hypothesis: After the codec upgrade, the old code streams can still be decoded, and the compatibility matrix should be included in the release notes.

samples.source: 这个文件需要软编解码器而不是系统自带的那个。
samples.reference: This file needs the software codec rather than the system one.
samples.hypothesis: This file requires a software codec instead of the one included in the system.

samples.source: 编解码器协商要看双方都支持的档位，不能只看自己声明的列表。
samples.reference: Codec negotiation must look at what both sides support, not just one's own advertised list.
samples.hypothesis: The codec negotiation requires the level supported by both parties, not just the list declared by one side.

samples.source: 容器格式选错会让字幕轨被丢弃，即使视频轨看起来正常。
samples.reference: A wrong container format can drop the subtitle track even while video looks fine.
samples.hypothesis: Choosing the wrong container format will cause the subtitle track to be discarded, even if the video track appears normal.

samples.source: 同一段素材换容器格式封装后，时长元数据可能有几毫秒差异。
samples.reference: Re-muxing the same material into another container can shift duration metadata by a few milliseconds.
samples.hypothesis: After the same material is packaged in a different container format, there may be a few milliseconds' difference in the duration metadata.

samples.source: 混音要把对白、配乐与音效分轨处理，而不是在一条轨上叠。
samples.reference: A mix should treat dialogue, music and effects as separate stems rather than stacked on one track.
samples.hypothesis: The mixing process requires separating dialogue, music, and sound effects into separate tracks, rather than stacking them together on one track.

samples.source: 混音后的响度目标要按交付平台要求设定，不是越响越好。
samples.reference: Set the loudness target of the mix to the delivery platform's requirement, not as loud as possible.
samples.hypothesis: The target loudness of the mix should be set according to the delivery platform requirements; it's not that the louder the better.

samples.source: 混音阶段保留头部空间，避免后期压缩再次抬升噪声。
samples.reference: Leave headroom during mixing so later compression does not lift the noise floor.
samples.hypothesis: Keep the headspace during mixing to avoid noise increase due to later compression.

samples.source: 分轨导出时每条轨的起始时间必须一致，否则合回会错位。
samples.reference: Exported stems must share one start time, or reassembling them misaligns.
samples.hypothesis: The start time of each track must be consistent during track export, otherwise the merge will be misaligned.

samples.source: 干声里残留的伴奏会被识别成语音，导致转写出现幻听内容。
samples.reference: Accompaniment left in the dry vocal is recognised as speech and invents transcript content.
samples.hypothesis: The accompaniment remaining in the dry sound will be recognized as idioms, causing transcriptions to contain auditory hallucinations.

samples.source: 配音的干声要单独留档，混音之后就无法再分离。
samples.reference: Keep the dubbing dry vocal archived on its own; after the mix it can no longer be separated.
samples.hypothesis: The dry sound of the voiceover should be saved separately, and it cannot be separated after mixing.

samples.source: 音轨表里的声道映射要按容器写，不按播放器显示顺序。
samples.reference: Map channels in the track table according to the container, not the player's display order.
samples.hypothesis: The channel mapping in the audio track table should be written according to the container, not the display order of the player.

samples.source: 路由规则改一次就要重跑覆盖矩阵，否则报表描述的不是当前配置。
samples.reference: Rerun the coverage matrix after any change to the routing table, or the report describes a stale configuration.
samples.hypothesis: Every time the routing rules are changed, the coverage matrix needs to be rerun, otherwise the report does not reflect the current configuration.

samples.source: 这里的路由指引擎选择路由，不是网络路由表。
samples.reference: The routing here means engine selection, not a network routing table.
samples.hypothesis: The routing engine here selects routes, not the network routing table.

samples.source: 视频片段切片要以关键帧为界，否则会解出花屏。
samples.reference: Video clip cuts must land on keyframes, or the result decodes as corrupted.
samples.hypothesis: The video segment slices should be based on key frames to avoid screen tearing.

samples.source: 切片工具对无关键帧的长图像组支持有限，需要先重编码。
samples.reference: Splitting tools handle long groups of pictures poorly without re-encoding first.
samples.hypothesis: The slicing tool has limited support for long image groups without keyframes, and re-encoding is required first.

samples.source: 表格数据作为字幕源时要防公式注入，导出侧也要转义。
samples.reference: Spreadsheet data used as subtitle source needs formula-injection guards on both sides.
samples.hypothesis: When using table data as a subtitle source, prevent formula injection, and escape characters should also be applied on the export side.

samples.source: 表结构变更要向后兼容，旧素材没有新字段是常态。
samples.reference: Keep the table schema backward compatible; old assets without the new field are the norm.
samples.hypothesis: Table structure changes must be backward compatible, and it is common for old materials to lack new fields.

samples.source: 帧率是媒体属性不是剪辑属性，导出侧不要二次换算。
samples.reference: Frame rate is a media property, not an editing one; do not convert it twice on export.
samples.hypothesis: Frame rate is a media attribute, not a editing attribute, so no further conversion is needed on the export side.

samples.source: 模型的部分权重损坏时应整体拒绝加载，而不是静默补齐。
samples.reference: If part of the model weights are corrupt, refuse the checkpoint instead of silently filling in.
samples.hypothesis: When some weights of the model are damaged, the loading should be completely rejected instead of being silently repaired.

samples.source: 词表不匹配时子词切分会退化成逐字符，推理质量随之崩塌。
samples.reference: On a vocabulary mismatch, subword tokenisation degrades to per-character and quality collapses.
samples.hypothesis: When the vocabulary doesn't match, subword splitting degrades to character-by-character processing, resulting in a collapse of reasoning quality.

samples.source: 流水线在队列满时给的是拒绝还是等待，必须是可观测的。
samples.reference: Whether the pipeline rejects or waits on a full queue has to be observable.
samples.hypothesis: The pipeline should indicate rejection or waiting when the queue is full, and this must be observable.

samples.source: 队列策略变更会影响首包延迟，回归里要一起看。
samples.reference: A queue policy change moves time to first packet, so keep it in the same regression.
samples.hypothesis: Queue policy changes will affect the first packet delay, which needs to be considered together during regression testing.

samples.source: 缓冲与缓冲区的译法在中文里同形，英文要统一为 buffer。
samples.reference: Buffering and buffer both read the same in Chinese; keep one English word for them.
samples.hypothesis: The translation for "buffer" and "buffer zone" is the same in Chinese, so in English, it should be uniformly "buffer".

samples.source: 数据流与流式传输在文档里要区分，一个是内容一个是传输方式。
samples.reference: Separate the data stream from streaming transport in docs: one is content, the other is how it travels.
samples.hypothesis: Data flow and streaming should be distinguished in documents; one is the content and the other is the transmission method.

samples.source: 检查点是指模型权重还是任务断点，句子里要靠上下文消除歧义。
samples.reference: Say from context whether checkpoint means model weights or a resume point.
samples.hypothesis: Whether a checkpoint refers to model weights or task breaks depends on the context to eliminate ambiguity.

samples.source: 流水线的段与语音分段段是两个概念，命名要分开。
samples.reference: A pipeline stage and a speech segment are different notions; name them apart.
samples.hypothesis: The segments of the pipeline and the speech segmentation segments are two different concepts; their naming should be separated.

samples.source: 声道与通道在英文里是同一个词，所以中文界面必须按领域强制选一个。
samples.reference: Channel covers both senses in English, so the Chinese interface must pick one by domain instead of defaulting.
samples.hypothesis: The terms "channel" and "channel" are the same in English, so the Chinese interface must force a selection based on the context.

samples.source: 关键帧与首帧不是同一件事，预览逻辑要按可解码帧判断。
samples.reference: A keyframe is not the first frame; preview logic must decide on decodable frames.
samples.hypothesis: Key frames and the first frame are not the same thing; the preview logic should be based on decodable frames.

samples.source: 词元与子词在计费与切分上口径不同，报表不能混用。
samples.reference: Tokens and subwords differ for billing and for segmentation; do not share one metric.
samples.hypothesis: The metrics and sub-words have different definitions in billing and segmentation, so they cannot be used interchangeably in reports.

samples.source: 比特率与码率在文档里统一用一个词，避免读者以为两项指标。
samples.reference: Keep bitrate and rate control terminology distinct but consistent, or readers see two metrics.
samples.hypothesis: Bitrate and bitrate are referred to by the same term in the document to avoid readers confusing the two metrics.

samples.source: 分块与批处理是两回事，分块是流式内的窗口。
samples.reference: Chunking is not batching; chunking is a window inside streaming, batching is a group of requests.
samples.hypothesis: Chunking and batch processing are two different things; chunking refers to windows within a stream.

samples.source: 重采样与重新量化都要声明，混在一起会掩盖质量损失。
samples.reference: Declare resampling and requantisation separately, or one hides the other's damage.
samples.hypothesis: Both resampling and re-quantization must be declared, and mixing them together will mask the quality loss.

samples.source: 编码器预设档位与质量参数冲突时应报错，不是静默取一个。
samples.reference: Error out when an encoder preset and an explicit quality flag conflict, rather than silently choosing one.
samples.hypothesis: An error should be reported when the encoder preset gear and quality parameters conflict, rather than remaining silent.

samples.source: 解码器在硬件与软件之间回退时，要记录回退原因。
samples.reference: Record why the decoder fell back from hardware to software.
samples.hypothesis: When the decoder retreats between hardware and software, the reason for the retreat should be recorded.

samples.source: 容器与编解码器的能力列表不一致，以容器约束为准。
samples.reference: When container and codec capabilities disagree, the container's constraint wins.
samples.hypothesis: The capability list for the container and codec differs, and the container constraints shall prevail.

samples.source: 混音轨数超过容器上限时，要先给可执行提示再失败。
samples.reference: Warn before failing when the mix exceeds the container's track limit.
samples.hypothesis: When the number of mixing tracks exceeds the container limit, an executable prompt must be given before the failure occurs.

samples.source: 干声质量决定配音可懂度，伴奏残留的代价是转写错字。
samples.reference: Dry vocal quality drives dubbing intelligibility; leftover accompaniment shows up as transcript errors.
samples.hypothesis: Voice quality determines the comprehensibility of the dub, and the cost of background music residues is mistranscription of characters.

samples.source: 表格导入的字幕时长若缺列，要按行报错而不是补默认值。
samples.reference: Report the row when a subtitle sheet lacks a duration column, instead of defaulting it.
samples.hypothesis: If the subtitle duration for table import is missing a column, an error should be reported per row instead of filling in default values.

samples.source: 帧序号在跨段拼接后必须重排，否则解码顺序与显示顺序倒挂。
samples.reference: Renumber frames after concatenation, or decode order and display order invert.
samples.hypothesis: The frame sequence must be rearranged after segment concatenation, otherwise the decoding order and display order will be reversed.

samples.source: 路由决策要能回读，只给结果不给路径无法排障。
samples.reference: Routing decisions must be readable back; a result without a path cannot be debugged.
samples.hypothesis: The routing decision should be readable back; only providing results without the path makes it impossible to troubleshoot.

samples.source: 词表的领域覆盖决定子词切分好坏，通用词表在专名上会碎。
samples.reference: A vocabulary's domain coverage decides subword quality; a general one shreds proper nouns.
samples.hypothesis: The coverage of the vocabulary domain determines the quality of sub-word segmentation; a general vocabulary table will break down specialized terms.

samples.source: 缓存失效在跨版本场景要按语言对粒度，而不是全局清空。
samples.reference: Expire the cache per language pair across versions rather than clearing it globally.
samples.hypothesis: Cache invalidation in cross-version scenarios should be done by language granularity, rather than a global clear.

samples.source: 自动评测不能替代人工评测，窄域上指标与人工打分相关性明显下降。
